$description: Legacy-derived vocal precedent bank manifest. Maps canonical Casperaki genres + segmentType (verse / preChorus / chorus / bridge) → a melodic precedent bank + an optional rhythmic precedent bank + a per-style maxNote override. Mirrors `MelodyClass._getMergedRhythmicAndMelodicPrecedent` (vocals/MelodyClass.js lines 1098-1665) verbatim.

$dispatcherNotes.$1: When `cheesy` is set, the dispatcher hard-overrides every genre to schlager (both melodic + rhythmic). The brain port does not yet surface a `cheesy` flag and so leaves the override out of the data table.
$dispatcherNotes.$2: verse uses `limitedRange` and `maxNote = 55` for ballad / brightPop / latin / organicVibes / urban; `drLuke` and `maxNote = 55` for edm / schlager / rock.
$dispatcherNotes.$3: chorus uses `schlager` for catchyness across every genre.
$dispatcherNotes.$4: preChorus / bridge / other fall through to `stefan` (variety) except rock-preChorus which uses `drLuke`.
$dispatcherNotes.$5: Rhythmic banks are tempo-windowed: ballad split at 80bpm, brightPop split at 113bpm, edm split at 133bpm, organicVibes split at 93bpm, rock-as-dance split at 115bpm. Each split takes the first or last `length - 5` slice — i.e. drops the slow or the fast 5 entries.
$dispatcherNotes.$6: Rock-verse uniquely uses drLuke for BOTH melodic and rhythmic (legacy code line 1286 sets `rhythmicStructurePrecedents = drLukePrecedents`).
$dispatcherNotes.$7: `melodic` is one bank id (every legacy rule; the legacy path and its random draws, unchanged) or a list of bank ids, e.g. "melodic": ["hooks", "schlager"]. With a list the pool is the union of the listed banks: first a bank is picked, every listed bank equally likely (so the ~100 hooks are not drowned by the 1201 stefan entries), then an entry of that bank. A legacy bank picked from a list behaves exactly as a single-bank rule naming it (rhythmic bank, tempo split and maxNote of the rule apply).
$dispatcherNotes.$8: `hooks` names the hooks bank (our own complete 8-bar melodies with chords, built by scripts/build-hooks.mjs from data/vocals/hooks/*.hooks; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-24-hook-library-design.md) and `wholeShare`. The hooks bank may only appear inside a `melodic` list, never as a single string or a rhythmic bank. Only hooks with tempoMin <= song tempo <= tempoMax are candidates; if none suits the tempo the hooks bank drops out of the bank choice, and if the rule lists no other bank generation stops with an error naming the section and tempo.
$dispatcherNotes.$9: A picked hook is used whole (its own rhythm, notes and chords) with probability `wholeShare`; otherwise it gives the pitch shape and chords and a second, different hook from the same tempo-filtered pool gives the rhythm (the legacy n x n mixing, among hooks only). The rule's rhythmic bank is not used for hooks. A lead-in bar (start 1, end 9) is cut off like the legacy start-1 entries. No genre rule lists the hooks bank yet: the owner auditions the hooks first.
